Startup Web App MVP for $15K

You can launch a web app that works from day one. We build it for $15K, own the code, and host it for free on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

How it works for a founder launching a new SaaS

  1. Define the MVP – We capture your core features and user flow.
  2. Design & build – Custom UI, admin panel, and spreadsheet‑based events.
  3. Deploy – Your site goes live in about a week.
  4. Launch – We hand you the code, domain, and content ownership.
  5. Care – 90 days of free maintenance, then optional plans at $295/month or $595/month.

What you get

  • $15K total – 50% deposit, balance at launch.
  • Unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, spreadsheet events, email and form integrations.
  • Zero monthly hosting fee – $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • 90 days of free care after launch.
  • Optional care plans: $295/month or $595/month, cancel anytime.

FAQ

How long does the MVP take? Answer: About a week from design to launch.

Do I need to pay for hosting? Answer: No. Hosting is free on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

What happens after the 90 days of free care? Answer: You can choose a care plan at $295/month or $595/month, or cancel without penalty.

Get started with a startup web app MVP for $15K →
